name: waveline
description: Ask about Waveline calls, missed calls, voicemails, texts and contacts by inbox, teammate or customer; review transcripts and call analytics; manage inbox settings; and send explicitly approved text messages.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about calls, texts, and contacts.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Waveline account to ask about calls, missed calls, voicemails, text conversations and contacts by inbox, teammate or customer, read saved transcripts and summaries, and review call analytics. Choose Workspace or one permitted inbox and approve the requested permissions. Optional actions update contacts, add notes, manage inbox settings, and send approved text messages. Each accepted external recipient send costs US$0.01 before tax, added to your workspace invoice; existing messaging charges may also apply.
defaultPrompt: Which text conversations are waiting for a reply?
Draft a follow-up text for a customer. Ask before sending.
